summary: Careful, fully instrumented preregistered paired study that integrates a deterministic network verifier into an LLM Generate–Verify–Repair (GVR) pipeline and releases an extensive artifact bundle. Execution and analysis are reproducible and well‑logged. The run produced a provenance‑backed degenerate null (identical single generated candidate per pair; no verifier rejections; no repairs invoked). The manuscript is honest about this outcome, but several manuscript clarifications are required to avoid misinterpretation and to align the reported power/planned MDE with the executed generation semantics.
required_revisions: Make the estimand/testability mismatch explicit and prominent: in the Abstract and at the end of the Introduction, add an unambiguous statement that because the preregistered execution used shared_initial_candidate (independent_condition_generation=false) the preregistered primary estimand (a marginal increase in detection/rejection by inserting a verifier) was not testable as originally framed; state that the observed numbers therefore measure the verifier’s marginal effect conditional on an identical generated candidate per task. Cite the exact preregistration and the execution/model_configuration.json artifact (SHA‑256 a40e96e2...) to support this clarification.

Revise the Methods (Power/Precision) section to remove or qualify any standing numeric Minimum Detectable Effect (MDE) or power interpretation that assumed independent sampling between conditions. Explicitly state that the preregistered MDE calculations assumed independent generation per arm and are therefore inapplicable to the observed execution; point readers to the preregistration SHA‑256 and the executed configuration showing independent_condition_generation=false.

Add a concise reproducible follow‑up recipe in Methods or Discussion (one paragraph) that specifies the minimal change(s) required in the preregistration/execution JSON to enable a valid test of the original primary estimand (i.e., set independent_condition_generation=true; increase model_calls_used accordingly; optional parameter suggestions for temperature/seeds and repair budget). Reference exact JSON field names and artifact paths so readers can deterministically repeat the variant using the provided harness (resolvable from supplied artifacts).

In Results or Limitations, add one short paragraph clarifying that the bootstrap CI=[0.00,0.00] and p=1.0 are arithmetic consequences of zero discordant pairs (n10=n01=0) and therefore do not provide evidence that a verifier is ineffective in general; explain concisely why the reported inferential quantities are degenerate for this run and how they should be interpreted by readers.
optional_revisions: Add one or two sentences expanding the Related Work to cite recent LLM→NetOps GVR/validator papers (if available) and to position this artifact‑backed null among those results (nonessential but useful for context).

Include a short table or single paragraph enumerating the exact artifact paths and SHA‑256 hashes referred to in the Disclosure (e.g., preregistration JSON, master_prompt reference, model_configuration.json, execution_manifest.json) to make pointer discovery trivial for reviewers/readers (purely editorial).

Discuss, briefly, whether a post‑hoc simulation using alternative generation seeds (using the single stored generator trace(s)) could provide insight without new model calls; if such simulation is impossible with supplied artifacts, state that explicitly as an unresolved future step.
